info.name: Run an extractor on a collection, document, or uploaded files (synchronous)

params.name: extractor_id
params.description: ID of the extractor to run

params.name: collection_id
params.description: ID of the collection to run the extractor on. Exactly one of collection_id or document_id must be provided.

params.name: document_id
params.description: ID of the single document to run the extractor on. Exactly one of collection_id or document_id must be provided.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Timeout in seconds

items.docs:
Executes the specified extractor synchronously and returns results with a 200 OK response.

Exactly one of the following must be provided:
- `collection_id` — run on all documents in a collection
- `document_id` — run on a single document in a collection
- `files` — one or more files uploaded directly in the request body (multipart/form-data) without adding them to a collection

This endpoint blocks and waits for the extraction to complete, then returns the results.

info.name: Create a job to run an extractor on a collection or document

params.name: extractor_id
params.description: ID of the extractor to run

params.name: collection_id
params.description: ID of the collection to run the extractor on. Exactly one of collection_id or document_id must be provided.

params.name: document_id
params.description: ID of the single document to run the extractor on. Exactly one of collection_id or document_id must be provided.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Timeout in seconds

items.docs:
Creates a job to execute the specified extractor by running it on all documents
in a collection, or on a single document when document_id is specified.
This endpoint is designed for long-running extractions.

The endpoint immediately returns a 201 Created response with job details.

Exactly one of collection_id or document_id must be provided.

params.name: extractor_id
params.description: ID of the extractor

params.name: job_id
params.description: Optional job ID to retrieve results for a specific extraction run. If omitted, returns all results for this extractor.

params.name: offset
params.description: How many extraction results to skip before returning.

params.name: limit
params.description: How many extraction results to return.

items.docs:
Retrieves extraction results produced by this extractor. If job_id is specified,
returns results for that specific extraction run. If job_id is omitted, returns all
results produced by this extractor across all runs.
